name: bog_wail_flight
notes: A hurled knot of black bog water (lit olive highlights, foam flecks circling) dragging weed strands and water tails, shedding drips and spray, led by a quivering sickly-green tapered wail crescent with an echo ripple. Faces +x; anchor = glob centre. Crescent spans the 0.4-2.0 m band (48 px at 30 px/m).
